The dspk-cli-sorter program `sort` runs: install it, or show which one is used

```text
dspk sorters [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## `dspk sorters install`

Download and verify dspk-cli-sorter for this version and platform (GPL-3.0)

```text
dspk sorters install [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`--force`**  
  Download again even when it is installed

## `dspk sorters status`

Which dspk-cli-sorter `dspk sort` runs, and where installs go

```text
dspk sorters status [OPTIONS]
```
